clarity.notes: The viewer opens on a real table - the largest record type - so the first thing on screen is a grid whose columns mean something. The union of every type is still reachable, but it is named 'All types' rather than 'All records' and states its own limit in one line above the grid: a table can only show the fields all twelve types share. Switching table is one menu, listing types by the names the file already uses.

hierarchy.notes: Which table precedes how to draw it, left to right, and takes the wider control. The type field leaves the column set when one table is selected because the picker already answers that, and returns when the result spans more than one.

typography.notes: Inter for the picker label and lane labels, Fira Code with tabular numerics for every count so the menu's column of numbers holds still. The union note is mono at 11px, sitting with the other captions rather than styled as a warning.

motion.notes: Unchanged: three 90ms disclosures and the query spinner. The picker is a menu and opens like every other menu here.

brand.notes: No new tokens or color. The picker reuses .select and .menu; the union note reuses the caption treatment from the lazy-load sentinel. No gradients or filters anywhere in the stylesheet.
